title: metrics-service observability and evidence mechanisms

sources.license: NO PROJECT LICENSE GRANT FOUND AT PINNED REVISION

observations: Pinned v0.21.16 is a Go metrics runtime whose main path is config -> adapters -> aligned collection -> normalized snapshot -> concurrent sinks -> bounded query/operator surfaces.
The target has 52 tracked test files spanning unit, property, fuzz, contract, smoke, and pipeline E2E styles; go test ./... passed in the local pinned checkout.
GitHub metadata showed a private single-maintainer repository, three historical pull requests, no issues, unsigned tags, and GitHub Releases stopping at v0.19.0 while tags continue through v0.21.16.
No LICENSE, NOTICE, COPYING, or GitHub license metadata exists at the pinned revision; direct code reuse or redistribution is excluded without separate permission.
The strongest clean-room adaptations are aligned typed partial fleet evidence, component readiness with recovery actions, and registry-driven dashboard/alert drift auditing.

candidates.effect: Align fleet observations under one deadline and retain typed complete, partial, or failed outcomes.
candidates.outcome: Clean-room adaptation only: preserve successful peer witnesses, shared-window identity, stable ordering, and explicit completeness.

candidates.effect: Expose a typed component-readiness matrix with exact recovery actions on the native server path.
candidates.outcome: Clean-room adaptation only: enforcement-critical failures block readiness; optional exporters may degrade; every bad row carries a scrubbed next action.

candidates.effect: Drive dashboards and alert audits from one typed metric registry with cardinality and provenance contracts.
candidates.outcome: Clean-room adaptation only: keep native operation independent from Grafana and audit dimensions, provenance, counter semantics, units, and recovery/runbook coverage.

candidates.effect: Use strict default-overlay configuration with warnings distinct from startup-blocking errors.
evidence: fak has mature typed configuration, preflight, policy, doctor, and refusal/recovery surfaces across existing leaves.
candidates.outcome: No new issue: the general mechanism is already represented; unknown-field handling in the source is weaker than FAK should copy.

candidates.effect: Retain rich source-specific payloads through sink derivation, then compact before bounded storage.
evidence: fak already journals, scrubs, compacts, and emits bounded evidence through multiple domain-specific receipt paths.
candidates.outcome: Watch rather than file: the target pattern is useful, but a cross-kernel generic event store would risk conflating domain-specific retention and provenance contracts.

candidates.effect: Provide direct Grafana dashboard push from the service.
candidates.outcome: Exclude as a default: it expands credential and external-write authority; generation/download/audit should precede any separately guarded push capability.
